## Description

Brief description of the changes.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change that adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Testing

- [ ] Tests added/updated
- [ ] All tests pass (`npm test`)
- [ ] Linting passes (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] Verified against real hardware, if this changes what is sent to an appliance or how a response is read (say which model and firmware)

## Checklist

- [ ] Code follows existing style
- [ ] Self-reviewed the code
- [ ] Added comments for complex logic
- [ ] Updated documentation if needed
- [ ] `dist/` rebuilt and committed (`npm run build`). CI fails if it has drifted from `src/`
- [ ] No change to accessory identity, or the consequence is called out below (a changed identity re-creates the accessory in HomeKit and loses its room and automations)
- [ ] Conventional Commit PR title (CHANGELOG.md is generated by release-please, so do not edit it by hand)
